name: const unsafe fn as_mut_unchecked < 'a > (self) -> & 'a mut T
rule: When calling `as_mut_unchecked`, `self` must be convertible to a unique mutable reference `&'a mut T`.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > * mut T { const unsafe fn as_mut_unchecked < 'a > (self) -> & 'a mut T }
expression: This requirement is not expressible in the supplied DSL: it has no predicate for exclusive mutable access lasting for `'a`, which conversion to a unique `&'a mut T` requires.
